_about: Capability golden set for Layla — the kinds a MOCKED unit suite cannot prove: real tool selection/execution, memory-grounding (recall of a seeded fact), and same-session carry-over. Run against a LIVE server with a real (tiny) model via scripts/run_real_eval.py, which drives eval/run_golden.py. Cases tagged tier=fast form the gate-able subset; the rest are nightly. On a 360M model these are noisy by design — the harness reports per-kind pass/fail honestly rather than pretending a tiny model is a big one.

cases.prompt: What is the capital of France? One word.
What is 12 plus 7? Give only the number.
Use a tool to inspect the current directory and summarize its contents. Do not answer from memory.
List the files in the current working directory using the list_dir tool, then tell me what you found.
Search your saved memory for anything you know about the operator's preferred editor and report back.
